user_query: My friends and I are planning a hiking trip and we want to make sure we have all the necessary equipment and supplies. Can you provide us with guidelines on hiking essentials and safety precautions? Additionally, I would like to gather nutritional information for the trail snacks and meals we'll be packing. Your expertise in these areas would be greatly appreciated.

TaskList.description: Gather guidelines on hiking essentials, including clothing, equipment, and supplies needed for a safe hiking trip.
Collect safety precautions specific to hiking, covering potential hazards and first aid tips.
Identify and list popular trail snacks and meals suitable for hiking, focusing on nutritional value and energy content.
Research nutritional information for the identified trail snacks and meals, providing calorie counts, macronutrient breakdown, and any dietary considerations.
